mapper.select: select * from account where login_id=#{value} and status = 'ACTIVE'

select a.*, e.name as user_name, r.role_name, b.name as branch_name from account a left join employee e on a.emp_no = e.emp_no left join branch b on a.branch_code = b.branch_code left join role r on a.role_id = r.role_id where a.login_id=#{value} and a.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update account set last_login_at = now() where account_id = #{value}
